# Typo Hunter

> Typo Hunter is a free, private, offline-first web app for photographing and collecting typos, mistranslations and signage mistakes found in the real world ("The world is full of typos. Someone has to collect them."). Users build a personal typo museum, play QR-code games with friends without internet, and teachers can run class typo hunts where they review students' photos. No account, no tracking: all data stays on the user's device.

Key facts:

- Website: https://typo-hunter-topaz.vercel.app/ (front page)
- App: https://typo-hunter-topaz.vercel.app/app/ (installable Progressive Web App; works offline after the first visit)
- Reads the text in photos on the device (no upload) and flags misspelt words
- Price: free. Licence: MIT (open source)
- Accounts: none. Photos and notes are stored only in the browser on the user's device; the app contacts no third parties.
- Language of the interface: English

## Using the app
